intro: Misha is the loyal bear companion of Rexxar, the Champion of the Horde. She wanders Kalimdor faithfully at the half-ogre beastmaster's side.

p: Misha is a brown bear who walks at the side of the wandering Rexxar, a solitary spirit who trusts beasts more than people. Together they have forged a fierce, protective partnership that has weathered countless wildernesses and bloody battles.

Misha is far more than a tame pet; she is a seasoned warrior. She fought alongside Rexxar in the brutal conflict against Grand Admiral Daelin Proudmoore at Theramore Isle, helping ensure the young Horde's survival. When not in battle, her keen senses and strength serve as an extension of Rexxar's will.

Currently, travelers venturing along the long tracks through the Stonetalon Mountains, Desolace, and Feralas can spot Misha padding quietly beside Rexxar. Though fierce enough to tear apart any predator foolish enough to threaten them, she remains Rexxar's steadfast anchor in an otherwise untrustworthy world.
